summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, incorporating legal opinions from Linklaters LLP (Exhibits 5.1 and 5.2) related to the issuance of U.S.$1,000,000,000 4.800% Notes due 2031, U.S.$1,000,000,000 5.350% Notes due 2036, and U.S.$1,500,000,000 6.100% Notes due 2056. This is a routine debt offering with no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. The filing does not include transaction terms, premiums, or board recommendations; it purely covers the legal validity of the notes under English law.
